scope: April-16 AlphaGenome fold3/valid candidates restricted to chr1 and chr9; canonical GT/AG only
truth: CHESS 3.1.3 union of all-transcript exon-chain splice boundaries
upstream_filter: April-16 input contained only AlphaGenome Probability >= 0.1
metric: sklearn.metrics.average_precision_score with tied scores handled exactly

matched_precision.definition: precision at the first distinct-score threshold whose cumulative recall reaches or exceeds the target; tied predictions are never split

note: This architecture-matched analysis supersedes the historical 0.920 pure-Mamba value when discussing CNN--Mamba-k7.
